# Error codes

<Callout type="warn">
Every Kiteq error carries a stable code.
</Callout>

## KQ1042

Raised when a worker loses its lock on a job because the visibility timeout expired. Increase `lockDurationMs` or make the handler faster.

## KQ2001

Raised when the connection to the broker is refused. Check the host and the port.
